summary: Built the double-NAT path: node3(lan-a) -> node1(VyOS, SNAT to 10.10.2.1 entering transit) -> node2(OPNsense, SNAT to 10.10.3.254 entering lan-b) -> node4(HTTP:8080). Verified node4's access log records the source as node2's lan-b address (10.10.3.254) exclusively, never node3's or node1's real address. Restarted all four nodes one at a time per the mandatory protocol, confirmed boot-identity change on each, and re-verified the full double-NAT path and service health after every restart.
actions_performed: Mapped the physical topology via ARP/tcpdump evidence: node1 eth2<->node3 eth1 (lan-a), node1 eth1<->node2 vtnet1 (transit), node2 vtnet2<->node4 eth1 (lan-b) since interfaces were unaddressed and initial guesses about interface pairing were wrong

Configured lan-a (10.10.1.0/24), transit (10.10.2.0/24), lan-b (10.10.3.0/24) addressing; fixed AlmaLinux NetworkManager wiping raw 'ip addr add' by creating persistent nmcli connection profiles on node3/node4
Configured VyOS (node1): source NAT rule 100 masquerading 10.10.1.0/24 out eth1 (first translation, entering transit) plus static route 10.10.3.0/24 via 10.10.2.2

Configured OPNsense (node2): assigned vtnet1/vtnet2 as opt1(TRANSIT)/opt2(LANB) via config.xml surgery, added firewall pass rules on opt1/opt2, switched outbound NAT to hybrid mode with explicit SNAT rule on opt2 (second translation, entering lan-b, source rewritten to 10.10.3.254), applied via configctl interface reconfigure + configctl filter reload
Added static route on node3 for 10.10.3.0/24 via node1's lan-a IP; opened node4 firewalld port 8080/tcp which was rejecting with admin-prohibited
Started HTTP server on node4:8080 and validated node3 curl requests succeed end-to-end, with node4 access log consistently showing source 10.10.3.254

Captured boot-identity baselines on all 4 nodes (boot_id / kern.boottime), then restarted node3, node4, node1, node2 one at a time via native reboot, polled until exec was available again, confirmed boot-identity changed for each, and re-verified persisted config plus full double-NAT connectivity and correct source recording after each restart

evidence.requirement: Baseline: healthy pre-restart boot identity and service state on every node
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id (Linux nodes) / kern.boottime (FreeBSD node2) baselines: node1=5bcff8f9..., node2 boottime 04:22:29, node3=4a743885..., node4=31b01b46...

evidence.requirement: Double-NAT path functions: node3->node1(NAT)->transit->node2(NAT)->node4, arriving as node2's address
evidence.summary: curl from node3 to node4:8080 succeeds; node4's HTTP access log shows source 10.10.3.254 (node2's lan-b IP) for every request, confirming the double translation and that node3/node1's real addresses are never visible to node4

evidence.requirement: node1 (VyOS) performs first SNAT as traffic enters transit; node2 (OPNsense) performs second SNAT as traffic enters lan-b
evidence.summary: VyOS 'show nat source rules' shows rule 100 masquerading 10.10.1.0/24 out eth1; OPNsense pfctl -s nat shows 'nat on vtnet2 inet all -> (vtnet2:0)' hybrid rule; packet capture on node3 shows the reflected ICMP unreachable arriving with original addressing restored by conntrack, confirming the forwarding/NAT chain was traversed correctly end-to-end before the node4 firewalld fix

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered service/data and cluster path
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; subsequent call timed out (node down); boot_id changed from 4a743885... to 6cec21df...; nmcli lan-a connection and static route persisted; end-to-end curl through the double-NAT path succeeded post-reboot

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered service/data and cluster path
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; subsequent call timed out; boot_id changed from 31b01b46... to f719d306...; firewalld port rule and IP config persisted; HTTP server restarted; end-to-end curl succeeded and access log again shows source 10.10.3.254

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered service/data and cluster path
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; subsequent calls timed out/reset; boot_id changed from 5bcff8f9... to 525b2667...; VyOS NAT rule 100 and static route 10.10.3.0/24 persisted via config.boot; end-to-end curl through the path succeeded post-reboot

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered service/data and cluster path
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; subsequent call failed with SSH connection timed out; kern.boottime changed from 04:22:29 to 04:38:49; opt1/opt2 interface assignments and hybrid outbound NAT rule persisted in config.xml; end-to-end curl succeeded and node4 log confirms source is still 10.10.3.254 after node2's restart
